data.title: Bitcoin and ethereum prices today, Monday, October 5, 2026: Bitcoin back above $86,000 after higher rate expectations fade
data.description: Bitcoin opened at $86,513.38 on Monday, October 5, 2026, up 2.1% from Sunday's opening price. As of 7:37 a.m. ET this morning, bitcoin dipped to $86,121.88. Ethereum opened at $2,726.72, up 1.5% from Sunday's opening price. The price of ethereum moved slightly lower this morning to $2,717.55 as of 7:37 a.m. ET.
